Ava (Marketing): Heads-up: we need hero assets for the upcoming benchmark launch. Requirements: animated hero for blog, static PNG fallback, LinkedIn crop, email header. Deadline: Thurs EOD.
Riley (Design): OK. Can you confirm sizes and file-size targets? GIFs tend to balloon.
Ava (Marketing): Blog hero ~1200px wide (responsive), LinkedIn 1200x627, email 600x200. Try to keep GIFs <1MB (blog/social) and <200KB for email if possible.
Noah (DesignOps): To hit those targets we'll use 8-bit palettes + frame culling. Recommend master at 1200x528; export optimized variants at 800x352 for blog GIF, 1200x627 for linkedin, 600x200 for email with static fallback.
Riley (Design): Plan: short loop (1.5s), minimal text overlays, no flashing >3Hz. Will add alt text and a caption in the Figma notes.
Priya (Content): Caption suggestion: "Benchmark Pulse: latency vs. cost tradeoffs clarified." Alt: "Animated chart showing latency and per-token cost trends for Redwood Inference."
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: provide a text transcript for any on-screen copy and include an alt + caption. Avoid rapid flashes.
Noah (DesignOps): I'll add an export job and post S3 links once done. My pipeline will run gifsicle -O3 with lossy=80 and produce a blog-fallback.png.
Riley (Design): I'll upload drafts to Figma by Tuesday and final exports Wednesday. Tagging Ava when ready.
Ava (Marketing): Perfect. Please ping when assets are in s3://redwood-marketing/benchmark-launch/ so we can schedule the post. Thanks!
